query: AI systems intended to interact directly with natural persons, deployed by a provider or deployer to respond to queries from natural persons concerning products, and the transparency obligations requiring that the natural persons concerned are informed that they are interacting with an AI system.
AI systems intended to interact directly with natural persons that generate synthetic audio, and the transparency obligations applicable to such systems.

The transparency obligations applicable to a generative AI system that generates synthetic image content, including the marking of such outputs as artificially generated or synthetic and the obligations of the provider of such a system placing it on the market or putting it into service.
AI systems intended to be used for recruitment or selection of natural persons, in particular for filtering or screening of job applications or evaluating candidates, as high-risk AI systems.
a system that scores university applications and decides which applicants are admitted

An AI system intended to be used for making or directly informing a human decision relating to promotion of natural persons in work-related relationships, and to monitor and evaluate the performance and behaviour of persons in such relationships, as a high-risk AI system.

Obligations applicable to high-risk AI systems intended to be used for credit scoring or the evaluation of creditworthiness of natural persons that were placed on the market before the date of application and have since undergone a substantial modification, as addressed by the transitional provisions.

Transitional provisions applicable to a high-risk AI system intended to be used for recruitment or selection of natural persons that was placed on the market before the date on which the obligations shall apply, where the system has undergone a substantial modification to its user interface.

Obligations applicable to a high-risk AI system placed on the market and subsequently made available on the market in additional Member States, in relation to the date of application and transitional provisions.
The date of application of the obligations of a provider of a high-risk AI system, and the provisions that shall apply from that date, including any applicable transitional measures.

The date of application of the provisions concerning prohibited AI practices, including the entry into force of the obligations to ensure compliance with such prohibitions and the applicability of the corresponding penalties.
Obligations applicable to providers of general-purpose AI models and the date of application of those obligations, including any transitional provisions.
